category_edits.rationale: Reduce causal history length to max(1, floor(0.75 × current length)), changing the default from 128 to 96. Existing truncation retains recent interactions in chronological order. Saved maxlen metadata applies the same limit in the generated predictor across all four datasets; the GRU, readout, loss, and optimizer remain unchanged.

change_summary: Shorten training, validation, and prediction context by 25% through the shared MAXLEN setting and existing checkpoint metadata.
